summary: Verified 3 new features (WhatsApp per dossier, admin password change, FR/EN language selector) end-to-end on backend + frontend, plus regressions. Backend: added /app/backend/tests/test_new_features.py (7 tests) — all pass; full suite = 40/41 pass with 1 flaky ERROR that is a parallel-test race, not a product bug (session-scoped login fixture in backend_test.py::TestContactAdmin ran concurrently with test_new_features::test_full_change_flow_and_restore's temporary password swap window on the same server). Verified via isolated re-run: backend_test.py alone = 11/11 pass. Admin password successfully changed to a temp, login with temp confirmed, then RESTORED to 'GlsAdmin2019!' — final curl login returns 200. /api/track never leaks client_phone (POST /api/dossiers with '+243 970 123 456' → GET /api/dossiers returns it, GET /api/track/{ref} strips it). Frontend: FR default; EN toggle updates nav to Home/About/Services/Sectors/Team/Partners/Tracking/Contact, hero 'Logistics & customs excellence', CTA 'Request a quote', tracking title 'Track your customs clearance in real time', tracking valid GLS-2026-RIAYO3J8 shows 'Customs declaration' status, unknown ref shows 'No file found with this reference'; localStorage 'gls-lang'='en' persists across reload; switch back to FR restored. Admin: 'Paramètres' tab visible with settings-current/new/confirm-password + submit; mismatched confirm → French toast 'Les deux mots de passe ne correspondent pas'; new pwd <8 chars → toast 'Le nouveau mot de passe doit contenir au moins 8 caractères' (no API call). Dossier form has 'Téléphone WhatsApp du client' field (data-testid='dossier-phone'); creating WITH phone → row has green [data-testid='dossier-whatsapp-{REF}'] with href starting 'https://wa.me/243970123456?text=' and URL-encoded body containing the reference; creating WITHOUT phone → no WhatsApp button on that row. Regression: WhatsApp floating button data-testid='whatsapp-button' present; Messages tab loads (28 total). Delete via window.confirm still works.
critical_code_review_comments: test_new_features.py runs the change-password flow with a ~200ms window where the admin password is temporarily NEW_PWD; when combined with pytest-xdist -n 2 --dist loadscope AND another test file whose session-scoped fixture logs in during that window, the parallel worker sees 401. This is a test-isolation issue, not a server bug. If desired, move the change-password flow into its own file/module and mark it xfail-on-parallel, or serialize via a session-scoped lock. Current mitigation: file passes cleanly when run individually or when scheduling avoids the race.
SettingsPanel.jsx: hardcoded French copy ('Mettre à jour', 'Minimum 8 caractères'). Fine per spec (admin UI stays FR) but worth documenting.
DossiersPanel.jsx: WhatsApp link uses window.location.origin — good, but the built href re-runs on every render (cheap); consider useMemo for large lists. Non-blocking.
DossiersPanel.jsx: still uses window.prompt/confirm (already flagged in iter_5). Non-blocking.

If a parallel worker in another file does a fresh login during that ~200ms window, it will 401 — safe to re-run that specific test alone. Password is always restored (verified via post-run curl). Full parallel run takes ~83s. To reset all in-memory limiter state: 'sudo supervisorctl restart backend'.
